title.narrative: Our Media: A civil society action to generate media literacy and activism, counter polarisation and promote dialogue.

description.narrative:
Overall objective(s) (i.e. Impact) Contributing to enhanced regional cooperation and reinforced media freedom and integrity in the Western Balkans and Turkey.

Specific objective(s) (i.e. Outcome(s)

1. Increased capacity of media CSOs and other CSOs in urban and rural areas to generate effective MIL practices.

2. Media professionals and self-regulators encouraged to assume greater responsibility for promotion of MIL.

3. Citizens, the youth in particular, empowered to engage in media freedom activism to counter polarisation.

4. Raised awareness of key stakeholders on media trends, opportunities, and risks in the WBT region and how to proactively address them
